profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
💼 About Me
🚀 Senior Data Engineer | Cloud Data Pipelines | Big Data Platforms | ETL Automation | SQL | Spark

I’m a Senior Data Engineer with over 10 years of experience designing scalable ETL pipelines, automating data workflows, and building robust analytics solutions across cloud platforms like GCP, AWS, and Azure. I’ve led migrations from legacy systems to modern platforms like Databricks, built real-time and batch pipelines with Spark, Python, and SQL, and created dashboards using Tableau, QuickSight, and Looker to unlock business insights.

My journey began in software development and QA, and has evolved into cloud-based data engineering — supporting large-scale initiatives in industries like finance, cybersecurity, and healthcare. I’ve optimized pipelines from 4.5 hours to 1.5, automated reporting with Power Automate, and delivered end-to-end data solutions that drive business results.

Beyond my technical experience, I’m a lifelong builder and tech enthusiast. From reverse-engineering PC game files in high school to creating smart systems with Raspberry Pi, I love solving complex problems and creating tools that make an impact — in data, in business, and someday, in gaming.

📈 Always learning. Always building. Always leveling up.

✨ Fun Facts
• Built my first custom PC at age 15 and still upgrading today
• Programmed a Raspberry Pi to control elevator lifts using voice commands
• My first internship after college was in iOS app development
• Played football, wrestling, and track & field in high school
• Passionate about game development and modding classics in my spare time

positions.title: Big Data Engineer
positions.description:
As a Senior Data Engineer at Enhance IT, I delivered enterprise-scale data solutions for Fortune 500 clients across finance, cybersecurity, and healthcare. I led multiple high-impact projects involving cloud data migrations, real-time data integration, pipeline automation, and executive dashboarding. My work consistently drove measurable improvements in data reliability, performance, and business intelligence visibility.

Key Projects & Achievements:

🔹 Databricks Migration – Guardian Life Insurance
• Migrated 80+ ETL pipelines from AWS EMR (HiveQL/Presto) to Databricks Spark SQL
• Reduced processing time from 4.5 hours to 1.5 hours for key pipelines
• Implemented CI/CD deployment strategy and conducted validation with Tableau

🔹 Revenue & Market Development Dashboards – Palo Alto Networks
• Developed SFTP-based ingestion workflows and automated CSV processing
• Built Tableau, Looker, and QuickSight dashboards for executive visibility
• Integrated data from SAP, Allocadia, Ariba, and Salesforce

🔹 Cloud Integration Framework – PayPal
• Built scalable ETL pipelines using GCP, BigQuery, and PySpark
• Automated validation logic and improved QA metrics tracking
• Collaborated with SAP and 360 Insights teams for finance data alignment
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Big Data · Databricks · Spark SQL

projects.title: Cloud Data Pipeline Migration – PayPal
projects.description: Built scalable ETL pipelines using GCP’s BigQuery and PySpark to integrate data from SAP and 360 Insights. Designed modular Python scripts for rule-based validation and exception handling. Delivered clean, high-quality data for internal stakeholders and reporting teams.

projects.title: Revenue & MDF Dashboard Development – Palo Alto Networks
projects.description: Developed end-to-end ETL workflows to process partner revenue and marketing fund data. Automated ingestion from SFTP, transformed data, and exported curated datasets. Built executive dashboards using Tableau, Looker, and QuickSight to track KPIs and improve reporting across business units.
